title: Reasoning-Style Poisoning of LLM Agents via Stealthy Style Transfer: Process-Level Attacks and Runtime Monitoring in RSV Space
why_relevant: Introduces a novel process-level poisoning attack on RAG agents via stylistic manipulation of retrieved documents, plus a runtime monitor defense, directly addressing adversarial corruption of retrieved evidence and process-level calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on reasoning style rather than factual content; somewhat narrow attack vector.
